about: Starter projects for "make me a …" requests (README §8). Hivebubble copies one without its git history, installs its packages and starts it; Claude then adapts it. Licenses must allow reuse. Remote entries are pinned to a commit.

starters.title: Booking app
starters.description: Services, open time slots and a booking form, with bookings kept in the browser. Vite and React.

starters.title: Small business website
starters.description: A one-page site: what you offer, opening hours and how to find you. Vite and React.

starters.title: Blank React app (TypeScript)
starters.description: Vite's official React and TypeScript template: a clean start for anything else.
